ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central field; solid black peripheral banding along the trailing edge and lateral tips; brownish/tan mottling observed along the superior leading-edge margins and adjacent to the peduncle interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve along the trailing edge extending from the notch to the acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single prominent dark circular focal point on the lower-left quadrant; minor dark clusters localized at the far-right lateral tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct horizontal dark linear mark on the mid-left lobe; faint vertical linear disruptions visible near the central base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge profile consistent with significant cumulative physical trauma or environmental wear.
